descriptionHtml:
89 × 63.5cm. Walls on four sides. A front that drops.

Newlands is an orthopaedic dog sofa bed for small and medium dogs, 89 × 63.5 × 16.5cm, with an egg-crate foam base, a flannel cover, a waterproof liner and a non-slip base.

There is probably a bed in your house they have stopped using. Not torn, not flat, just quietly abandoned some time last winter. Nine times out of ten it has a wall the whole way round, and one morning getting over it stopped being worth the effort.

Newlands runs the bolster right round but drops the front section low. The way in stays the same as the dog gets stiffer, which is the part most beds get wrong.

What they get

  • A surround on all four sides: A back or a chin has something solid against it wherever they settle.
  • A dropped front section: Getting in stays a step rather than becoming a climb.
  • A profiled egg-crate foam base: Profiled foam that holds its shape instead of going flat in the middle.
  • Flannel on top and a waterproof liner beneath: Soft where they lie and sealed around the core.
  • A non-slip base: The bed stays put on laminate when a small dog launches into it.

Best for: small and medium dogs who like walls, dogs getting on in years, and slippy floors.

Why it is worth the money

£165 is a lot for a bed that fits a spaniel, so here is where it goes. The lowered front is the detail that keeps this one useful for years rather than months, because dogs get stiffer and nobody notices the exact week a bed stops being used. Underneath it there is an egg-crate base, a waterproof liner wrapped round the foam and a non-slip backing.

And you are not gambling the money. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

The honest part: a bolster on every side eats into 89 × 63.5cm, and we do not publish the internal figure. Measure them curled rather than stretched, and ask us if it is close.

Size and fit

SizeExternal (cm)Shape
One size89 × 63.5 × 16.5Bolster on four sides with a dropped front entry

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. The bolsters take up part of the outside footprint. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Everyday care

Remove the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Wipe the liner. Air-dry everything fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most

Is it big enough for a labrador?

It is 89 × 63.5cm outside and the four-sided bolster takes part of that. This one is built around small and medium dogs. A dog who sleeps stretched flat wants Easedale at 106.5 × 81.5cm instead.

Can I actually wash it?

The cover comes off and washes, following the sewn-in care label. Wipe the liner underneath with a damp cloth and let everything dry right through before it goes back on. The foam never goes near water.
